title: Announcement and newsletter links ignore the site's URL structure and point at 404s
description: item_front_matter.item_path builds /<section>/<slug>.html (or the directory or clean form) from the section and ITEM_URL_STYLE. On Machines on Machines, Stories live at /articles/<slug>/ (the type's segment), so the announce agent drafted https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/security/the-eternal-october.html, which redirects to a 404. The newsletter roundup uses the same builder. The link must come from the projection's own address for the Story (its link map), not be rebuilt.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Released in Papyrus 5.144.0 (PR 1814), deployed on MoM (Amplify job 151): a dry run builds https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/articles/the-eternal-october/. The newsletter roundup still rebuilds its own links; not part of this issue's announcement path.
